items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I played with him down there and I made an audition for that job... Joe Massara.

ctx.x: I worked with him down there where Jumbo's joint is today. I played with him down there and I made an audition for that job. And I was working in there with Ray McNamara. I think... And he come and got me to audition for a job. He said, do me a favor. Do me a favor. Do me a favor. He says, I want to make an audition for a guy. In fact, Joe Massara. When I went in there and made the place over there, we were hoisting in another place. And who walks in there is Joe Massara. I says, for Christ's sake, I'm working…
Do you remember when Ray worked for Beiersdorfer?
